snippet.title: Project Dukkha - Official Teaser | Unveil the Unknown
snippet.description:
Prepare to witness the beginning of a haunting journey.

Project Dukkha is a 2.5D adventure game that combines emotional storytelling with a distinctive visual style. In this teaser, we reveal the unsettling aftermath of a disaster—wreckage, silence, and a desperate struggle for survival.

🌫️ Features:
 • A uniquely crafted atmosphere that captures both despair and hope.
 • An emotional narrative told through powerful visuals and subtle details.
 • A minimalist, immersive design that invites you to explore a world left in ruins.

🔔 Follow Us for Updates:
Subscribe to our channel for more exclusive looks at the world of Project Dukkha.

👉 Coming soon to Steam for wishlisting! Stay tuned for updates and follow us on social media!
